scope: Active ribosomal complexes are isolated by “clicking” nascent peptides harboring AHA directly to dibenzocyclooctyne beads.

For the capture of active ribosome complexes, 0.4 absorbance units (AU) was transferred to a new tube and the volume was adjusted to 100 μl with freshly prepared W buffer. To this, 100 μl of dBeads was added and the mixture was incubated for 60 min at 4°C on a rotating wheel.
